skills.name: States of matter and changes of state

worked_example.problem: When iodine crystals are warmed gently, a purple gas appears and no liquid forms. What is this change called?
steps: Iodine goes from {f} straight to {t}, with no liquid in between.

cards.idea: Solid, liquid and gas: a solid keeps its shape, a liquid takes the shape of its container, a gas fills its container.
example: Kerosene in a lamp takes the shape of the lamp.

cards.idea: Melting, freezing, evaporation, condensation and sublimation are changes of state: no new substance is made.
A pure substance has a fixed melting point and boiling point. Pure water boils at {b} °C at normal pressure.
example: Salt water boils above {b} °C: it is not pure.

check.prompt: How can we tell that a sample of water is pure?

right.text: It boils at exactly 100 °C at normal pressure.

wrong.explain: Many impure liquids have no smell.
Temperature does not show purity; the boiling point does.

questions.prompt: A {p.f} changes into a {p.t}. What is this change called?

misconceptions.explain: Not this one. Which state does it start in, and which does it end in?

pick.why: A solid keeps its own shape.

pick.t: takes the shape of its container but keeps its volume
pick.why: A liquid takes the shape of its container but keeps its volume.

pick.t: spreads to fill the whole container
pick.why: A gas spreads to fill the whole container.

pick.t: Iodine crystals warmed in a beaker give a purple gas, with no liquid.
pick.why: Iodine crystals warmed in a beaker give a purple gas, with no liquid. This is sublimation.

pick.t: Candle wax becomes liquid near the flame.
pick.why: Candle wax becomes liquid near the flame. This is melting.

pick.t: A mirror in the bathroom becomes covered with water drops.
pick.why: A mirror in the bathroom becomes covered with water drops. This is condensation.

pick.t: A puddle disappears in the afternoon sun.
pick.why: A puddle disappears in the afternoon sun. This is evaporation.

pick.t: Hot lead poured into a mould becomes hard.
pick.why: Hot lead poured into a mould becomes hard. This is freezing.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: A pure substance has a fixed boiling point.
Condensation turns a gas into a liquid.

wrong.explain: Salt water is impure: it boils above 100 °C.
Steam is still water: boiling is a physical change.
